description: Horizontal wrapping flex row for groups of short items — tags, buttons, metadata. Attribute form: data-layout="cluster".

attributes.name: data-layout-gap
attributes.description: Gap between items, on the shared size scale.

attributes.name: data-layout-nowrap
attributes.description: Keep everything on one line; no wrapping.

attributes.name: data-layout-overlap
attributes.description: Overlap items in reverse order (avatar groups). Bare attribute = s.

childAttributes.name: data-container
childAttributes.description: Opt a semantic child back into container queries. The layout removes container-type from such children so they size to content; this restores it.
